scope: Restoration list from separate source-to-thesis audits of both papers. Covered material already present is indexed in the two detailed audits. Mathematical corrections are retained instead of restoring superseded errors.

items.description: Merged the papers around interpretability as a way to improve and control models; connected representation, backward semantics, method design and evaluation.
Added Doshi-Velez and Kim, Lipton, Murdoch et al., Geirhos et al., and two Ross et al. papers, keeping the existing model-correction and model-steering references.
Used interpretability/interpretable in authored thesis title, headings, keywords, captions and prose; retained accurate publication/method names and internal paths.
Restored the original ten-class single-IC-model input/gradient comparison and its qualitative limitation.
Restored the second DICIN digit-3 example (image_036), original factual/counterfactual observations, and the vanilla DIC stroke/background observation.
Restored forward/backward caches, supported-operation graph conversion, numerical precision and optional assimilation; distinguished the reported paper setup from the pinned implementation default.
Retained ELU/Swish implementation motivation and citations with the correction that finite ReLU replacement approximates these activations; separated this from the exact curvature construction.
Restored all four block-Jacobian calculations and the fixed-bias observation, preserving the corrected affine-readout and derivative conventions.
Restored omitted source citations at their conceptual claims and retained every active source reference, including appendix/nocite records; consolidated duplicate keys for identical works.
Restored the original Ancona et al. modified-gradient comparison in the shared backward-rule discussion.
Restored the original broader-impact discussion in the thesis conclusion with consistent terminology.
Retained the original paper disclosure as an explicitly attributed quote, distinguished from subsequent thesis and Lean assistance.
Fixed the Babel German-language mismatch so the German declaration displays the actual date.
Restored the source motivation about nonnegative-weight streams retaining learned parts without cancellation, alongside the fairness/domain-constraint motivation and its references.
Restored the original paper caption in full: sign split, stop/continue and route decisions, equilibrium trajectory distribution, and discounted input occupation measure.

original_text_policy: Retain original technical prose, equations, proofs, figures and tables where compatible with unified notation and documented corrections. The introduction and connecting passages integrate the shared motivation; the experimental protocols stay identifiable.
preservation_decisions: The introduction and conclusion connect the papers into one argument rather than duplicate both openings and endings. Original technical paragraphs, proofs, figures, tables and the overview caption are retained wherever compatible with the documented mathematical corrections.
Official publication titles, named methods and URLs keep their original spelling; authored exposition uses interpretability.
The original paper AI disclosure is attributed to that paper; a separate statement describes later thesis and Lean assistance.
